payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 21. Beating the fast path is not the same as beating FLA by 1.3x

problem.statement: GDN Chunk Forward Pitfalls (CuTeDSL, SM120) -- 21. Beating the fast path is not the same as beating FLA by 1.3x

payload.attempted: Stop as soon as CuTeDSL beats the local fast path or Triton wrapper.
payload.lesson: For acceptance, run same-process FLA comparison and compute `FLA / current`. V31 only became final after `0.6142 ms` vs FLA `0.8768 ms`, i.e. `1.4275x`.

established_fact.mechanism: The fast path and FLA varlen wrappers have different launch and specialization costs. A kernel can beat one wrapper and still be above the explicit target line.

payload.observed: V26-V29 beat the fast path but still missed the stronger FLA 1.3x target. V29 was `0.6859 ms`, while the recorded target was `<=0.6753 ms`.
payload.root_cause: The fast path and FLA varlen wrappers have different launch and specialization costs. A kernel can beat one wrapper and still be above the explicit target line.
